column2:
sacred(adj.)神聖的、宗教的、不可侵犯的
(無詞性變化)
sacred place 聖地
sacred duty 神聖的職責
The mountain is considered a sacred place by the local tribe.
(這座山被當地部落視為聖地。)
For him, family time on Sunday is sacred.
(對他來說，星期天的家庭時光是不可侵犯的。)

saddle(n./v.)馬鞍、坐墊、使承擔(負擔)
(無詞性變化)
in the saddle 騎在馬上、掌權
be saddled with 背負…
She climbed into the saddle and rode off.
(她跨上馬鞍騎馬離去。)
Many graduates are saddled with heavy student loans.
(許多畢業生背負著沉重的學貸。)

saint(n./v.)聖人、聖徒、封為聖徒
saintly(adj.)聖潔的
patron saint 守護聖徒
be no saint 並非完人
She has the patience of a saint with her little students.
(她對年幼的學生有聖人般的耐心。)
Saint Valentine's Day is celebrated on February 14.
(聖瓦倫丁節在二月十四日慶祝。)

salmon(n./adj.)鮭魚、鮭魚肉色的
(無詞性變化)
smoked salmon 燻鮭魚
salmon sushi 鮭魚壽司
Salmon swim upstream to lay their eggs.
(鮭魚會逆流而上產卵。)
Grilled salmon is rich in healthy fats.
(烤鮭魚富含健康的脂肪。)

salon(n.)美髮院、沙龍、會客廳
(無詞性變化)
hair salon 美髮院
beauty salon 美容院
She gets her hair cut at a salon near the station.
(她在車站附近的一家美髮院剪頭髮。)
The beauty salon is fully booked on weekends.
(那家美容院週末都約滿了。)

sandal(n.)涼鞋
(無詞性變化)
a pair of sandals 一雙涼鞋
leather sandals 皮涼鞋
He wore a pair of sandals to the beach.
(他穿了一雙涼鞋去海邊。)
Sandals are not allowed in the school laboratory.
(學校實驗室內禁止穿涼鞋。)

scan(n./v.)掃描、瀏覽、細看
scanner(n.)掃描器
scan a QR code 掃描QR碼
brain scan 腦部掃描
Scan the QR code to see the menu.
(掃描QR碼即可查看菜單。)
She quickly scanned the newspaper for job ads.
(她快速瀏覽報紙尋找徵才廣告。)

scandal(n.)醜聞、恥辱
scandalous(adj.)可恥的、醜聞的
political scandal 政治醜聞
cause a scandal 引起醜聞
The minister resigned after the scandal was exposed.
(醜聞曝光後，那位部長辭職了。)
It is a scandal that so much food goes to waste.
(有這麼多食物被浪費真是可恥。)

scar(n./v.)疤痕、創傷、留下傷痕
(無詞性變化)
leave a scar 留下疤痕
emotional scars 心理創傷
The cut healed, but it left a small scar on his knee.
(傷口癒合了，但在他膝蓋上留下一道小疤。)
The war scarred the whole generation emotionally.
(那場戰爭在整個世代心中留下了創傷。)

scenario(n.)情節、劇本、可能的情況
(無詞性變化)
worst-case scenario 最壞的情況
possible scenario 可能的情況
In the worst-case scenario, the event will be canceled.
(最壞的情況是活動會取消。)
The teacher asked us to imagine a scenario without electricity.
(老師要我們想像一個沒有電的情境。)

scent(n./v.)香味、氣味、嗅出
scented(adj.)有香味的
pleasant scent 宜人的香氣
on the scent 追蹤到線索
The scent of jasmine filled the garden.
(茉莉花的香味瀰漫整個花園。)
The dog scented danger and began to bark.
(那隻狗嗅出危險，開始吠叫。)

scheme(n./v.)計畫、方案、詭計、密謀
(無詞性變化)
color scheme 配色
scheme to 密謀做…
The town launched a recycling scheme to reduce waste.
(這個鎮推出一項回收方案以減少垃圾。)
They schemed to steal the company's secrets.
(他們密謀竊取公司的機密。)

scope(n.)範圍、機會、餘地
(無詞性變化)
beyond the scope of 超出…範圍
scope for improvement 改進的空間
This question is beyond the scope of today's lesson.
(這個問題超出了今天課程的範圍。)
There is still plenty of scope for improvement in your essay.
(你的文章仍有很大的進步空間。)

scramble(v./n.)爬、攀爬、爭奪、炒(蛋)
(無詞性變化)
scrambled eggs 炒蛋
scramble for 爭搶
Shoppers scrambled for the discounted items.
(購物者爭搶打折商品。)
We scrambled up the rocky hill to watch the sunrise.
(我們手腳並用爬上岩石山丘看日出。)

scrap(n./v.)碎片、廢料、廢棄
(無詞性變化)
scrap paper 廢紙、計算紙
scrap metal 廢金屬
Use the back of scrap paper for your calculations.
(用廢紙的背面來計算。)
The city decided to scrap the plan due to lack of money.
(市政府因資金不足決定取消這項計畫。)

script(n./v.)劇本、腳本、筆跡、編寫劇本
scriptwriter(n.)編劇
film script 電影劇本
write a script 寫劇本
The actors read through the script together.
(演員們一起讀了一遍劇本。)
She scripted the school play herself.
(她親自為學校話劇寫劇本。)

sector(n.)部門、領域、扇形
(無詞性變化)
private sector 民間部門
public sector 公部門
Jobs in the technology sector are growing quickly.
(科技業的工作機會正快速增加。)
The government is working with the private sector to create jobs.
(政府正與民間企業合作創造就業機會。)

segment(n./v.)部分、片段、分割
segmentation(n.)分割、區隔
market segment 市場區隔
line segment 線段
Young people are an important segment of the market.
(年輕人是重要的市場族群。)
Draw a line segment from point A to point B.
(從A點到B點畫一條線段。)

seminar(n.)研討會、專題討論課
(無詞性變化)
attend a seminar 參加研討會
hold a seminar 舉辦研討會
Our teacher attended a seminar on AI in education.
(我們老師參加了一場教育AI研討會。)
The university holds a seminar for new students every fall.
(這所大學每年秋天為新生舉辦專題講座。)

senator(n.)參議員
senate(n.)參議院
US senator 美國參議員
state senator 州參議員
The senator voted against the new tax bill.
(那位參議員對新稅法投下反對票。)
She became the youngest senator in the state's history.
(她成為該州史上最年輕的參議員。)

sensation(n.)感覺、轟動、轟動的事
sensational(adj.)轟動的、聳動的
burning sensation 灼熱感
cause a sensation 引起轟動
I felt a strange tingling sensation in my fingers.
(我的手指有一種奇怪的刺痛感。)
The young singer became an overnight sensation online.
(那位年輕歌手一夜之間在網路上爆紅。)

sensitivity(n.)敏感、靈敏度、體貼
sensitive(adj.)敏感的
cultural sensitivity 文化敏感度
sensitivity to light 對光敏感
The topic should be handled with great sensitivity.
(這個話題應該非常謹慎地處理。)
Some people have a strong sensitivity to noise.
(有些人對噪音非常敏感。)

sensor(n.)感應器、感測器
(無詞性變化)
motion sensor 動作感應器
temperature sensor 溫度感測器
The lights turn on automatically thanks to a motion sensor.
(多虧了動作感應器，燈會自動亮起。)
Smartphones contain many sensors, such as GPS and cameras.
(智慧型手機裡有許多感測器，像是GPS和相機。)

sentiment(n.)情緒、觀點、感傷
sentimental(adj.)感傷的、多愁善感的
public sentiment 民意
anti-war sentiment 反戰情緒
Public sentiment turned against the new policy.
(民意轉而反對這項新政策。)
I share your sentiments about the importance of education.
(我認同你對教育重要性的看法。)

sentimental(adj.)感傷的、多愁善感的、情感上的
sentiment(n.)情緒、感傷
sentimental value 紀念價值
get sentimental 變得感傷
This old watch isn't expensive, but it has great sentimental value.
(這支舊手錶不貴，但很有紀念價值。)
Grandpa gets sentimental when he looks at old photos.
(爺爺看著舊照片時會變得很感傷。)

sequence(n./v.)順序、一連串、按順序排列
sequential(adj.)連續的、按順序的
in sequence 依序
a sequence of events 一連串事件
Put the pictures in the correct sequence to tell the story.
(把圖片按照正確的順序排列來說故事。)
A strange sequence of events led to the accident.
(一連串奇怪的事件導致了這場意外。)

series(n.)系列、一連串、影集
(無詞性變化)
a series of 一連串的
TV series 電視影集
The police are investigating a series of robberies.
(警方正在調查一連串的搶案。)
I stayed up late watching a Korean TV series.
(我熬夜看韓劇。)

server(n.)伺服器、服務生
serve(v.)服務、供應
web server 網頁伺服器
server down 伺服器當機
The website crashed because the server was overloaded.
(網站因為伺服器超載而當機。)
The server brought us our drinks right away.
(服務生立刻把飲料端來給我們。)

session(n.)一段時間、會議、開會期間
(無詞性變化)
training session 訓練課程
in session 開會中、開庭中
The coach holds a training session every Saturday morning.
(教練每週六早上舉行一次訓練。)
Parliament is now in session.
(國會目前正在開會。)

setting(n.)背景、環境、設定
set(v.)設定、放置
natural setting 自然環境
privacy settings 隱私設定
The novel's setting is a small fishing village in Taiwan.
(這本小說的背景是台灣的一個小漁村。)
You should check the privacy settings on your social media account.
(你應該檢查社群帳號的隱私設定。)

shareholder(n.)股東
share(n.)股份
major shareholder 大股東
shareholder meeting 股東大會
The shareholders voted to approve the merger.
(股東們投票通過了這項合併案。)
He is the largest shareholder of the company.
(他是這家公司最大的股東。)

shatter(v.)粉碎、使破滅
shattered(adj.)極度疲憊的、心碎的
shatter into pieces 碎成片片
shatter dreams 使夢想破滅
The glass fell off the table and shattered into pieces.
(玻璃杯從桌上掉下來摔得粉碎。)
The injury shattered his dream of playing professionally.
(那次受傷粉碎了他打職業賽的夢想。)

shed(v./n.)流出、脫落、去除、棚子
(無詞性變化)
shed tears 流淚
shed light on 闡明、揭露
The new study sheds light on how sleep affects memory.
(這項新研究揭示了睡眠如何影響記憶。)
Trees shed their leaves in autumn.
(樹木在秋天落葉。)

sheer(adj./adv.)全然的、純粹的、陡峭的、陡峭地
(無詞性變化)
sheer luck 純屬運氣
sheer cliff 陡峭的懸崖
He passed the test by sheer luck.
(他通過考試純屬運氣。)
The sheer size of the crowd surprised the organizers.
(群眾的龐大規模令主辦單位大吃一驚。)

sheriff(n.)(美國)郡警長
(無詞性變化)
county sheriff 郡警長
local sheriff 當地警長
The sheriff arrested the suspect near the border.
(警長在邊界附近逮捕了嫌犯。)
In old Western movies, the sheriff always wears a star badge.
(在老西部片裡，警長總是配戴星形徽章。)

shield(n./v.)盾、保護物、保護、遮擋
(無詞性變化)
shield from 保護免於…
protective shield 保護罩
She shielded her eyes from the bright sun.
(她遮住眼睛擋住刺眼的陽光。)
The ozone layer acts as a shield against harmful rays.
(臭氧層是抵擋有害射線的屏障。)

shiver(n./v.)顫抖、發抖
shivery(adj.)發抖的
shiver with cold 冷得發抖
send shivers down one's spine 令人毛骨悚然
The children stood shivering in the cold rain.
(孩子們站在冰冷的雨中發抖。)
The ghost story sent shivers down my spine.
(那個鬼故事讓我毛骨悚然。)

shortage(n.)短缺、不足
short(adj.)短缺的
water shortage 缺水
labor shortage 勞力短缺
The island often faces a water shortage in summer.
(這座島嶼夏天常面臨缺水。)
Many hospitals are dealing with a shortage of nurses.
(許多醫院正面臨護理人力短缺。)

shove(v./n.)推、擠、猛推
(無詞性變化)
push and shove 推擠
shove into 把…塞進
People pushed and shoved to get on the crowded train.
(人們推擠著要擠上擁擠的列車。)
He shoved his clothes into the bag and rushed out.
(他把衣服塞進包包就衝出門。)

shrug(n./v.)聳肩
(無詞性變化)
shrug one's shoulders 聳肩
shrug off 不理會、對…不以為意
When I asked where Tom was, she just shrugged.
(我問湯姆在哪裡時，她只是聳聳肩。)
He shrugged off the criticism and kept working.
(他對批評不以為意，繼續工作。)

shuttle(n./v.)接駁車、太空梭、往返
(無詞性變化)
shuttle bus 接駁車
space shuttle 太空梭
A free shuttle bus runs between the station and the stadium.
(車站和體育館之間有免費接駁車。)
Passengers were shuttled to the airport by van.
(乘客們坐廂型車被接送到機場。)

sibling(n.)兄弟姊妹
(無詞性變化)
sibling rivalry 手足競爭
older sibling 哥哥或姊姊
Do you have any siblings?
(你有兄弟姊妹嗎？)
Sibling rivalry is common in families with young children.
(手足競爭在有年幼孩子的家庭中很常見。)

siege(n.)圍攻、包圍
besiege(v.)圍攻、圍困
under siege 被圍困
lay siege to 圍攻
The city was under siege for several months.
(這座城市被圍困了好幾個月。)
The army laid siege to the castle.
(軍隊圍攻了城堡。)

skeleton(n.)骨骼、骨架、骨幹
skeletal(adj.)骨骼的
human skeleton 人體骨骼
skeleton staff 最基本人手
The museum displays the skeleton of a huge dinosaur.
(博物館展示著一具巨大恐龍的骨骼。)
Only a skeleton staff works during the Lunar New Year holiday.
(農曆年假期間只有最基本的人手上班。)

skull(n.)頭骨、頭蓋骨
(無詞性變化)
fractured skull 頭骨骨折
skull and crossbones 骷髏頭標誌
A helmet protects your skull in an accident.
(安全帽能在意外中保護你的頭骨。)
The pirate flag showed a skull and crossbones.
(海盜旗上畫著骷髏頭和交叉骨頭。)

slam(n./v.)猛關、猛擊、砰的一聲、抨擊
(無詞性變化)
slam the door 砰地關上門
slam on the brakes 猛踩煞車
She slammed the door and ran upstairs.
(她砰地關上門跑上樓。)
The driver slammed on the brakes to avoid hitting the dog.
(司機猛踩煞車以免撞到狗。)

slap(n./v./adv.)摑、拍打、恰好地
(無詞性變化)
a slap in the face 一記耳光、侮辱
slap on the back 拍背(表示鼓勵)
Being ignored by the judges felt like a slap in the face.
(被評審忽視讓人覺得像挨了一記耳光。)
He slapped his friend on the back and congratulated him.
(他拍拍朋友的背向他道賀。)

slavery(n.)奴隸制度、奴役
slave(n.)奴隸
abolish slavery 廢除奴隸制度
modern slavery 現代奴役
Slavery was abolished in the United States in 1865.
(美國在一八六五年廢除了奴隸制度。)
Millions of people still live in conditions of modern slavery.
(仍有數百萬人生活在現代奴役的處境中。)

slot(n./v.)投幣口、狹縫、時段、插入
(無詞性變化)
time slot 時段
slot machine 吃角子老虎機
Insert a coin into the slot to start the machine.
(把硬幣投進投幣口啟動機器。)
The show was moved to a later time slot.
(這個節目被移到較晚的時段。)

smash(v./n.)打碎、猛擊、轟動的成功
smashing(adj.)極好的
smash into 猛撞上
smash hit 大受歡迎的作品
The car smashed into a tree on the icy road.
(車子在結冰的路上猛然撞上一棵樹。)
The movie was a smash hit around the world.
(這部電影在全世界大賣。)

smog(n.)霧霾、煙霧
smoggy(adj.)煙霧瀰漫的
heavy smog 嚴重霧霾
smog alert 霧霾警報
Heavy smog covered the city for days.
(嚴重的霧霾籠罩城市好幾天。)
Car exhaust is a major cause of smog.
(汽車廢氣是造成霧霾的主因之一。)

snatch(v./n.)搶奪、抓住、片段
(無詞性變化)
snatch away 奪走
bag snatching 搶皮包
A thief snatched her purse and ran away.
(一名小偷搶了她的錢包就跑。)
I only heard snatches of their conversation.
(我只聽到他們談話的片段。)

sneak(v./n.)偷偷溜走、偷偷做、鬼鬼祟祟的人
sneaky(adj.)鬼鬼祟祟的
sneak out 偷溜出去
sneak peek 搶先看
He tried to sneak out of the house after midnight.
(他半夜過後試圖偷偷溜出家門。)
The studio released a sneak peek of the new movie.
(片商釋出了新電影的搶先看片段。)

sniff(v./n.)嗅、聞、抽鼻子
(無詞性變化)
sniff around 四處嗅、打探
take a sniff 聞一下
The dog sniffed the ground looking for food.
(那隻狗在地上嗅來嗅去尋找食物。)
She took a sniff of the milk to see if it had gone bad.
(她聞了一下牛奶，看看是否壞掉了。)

soak(v./n.)浸泡、濕透、浸泡
soaking(adj.)濕透的
soak up 吸收
get soaked 全身濕透
Soak the beans in water overnight before cooking.
(煮之前先把豆子泡水一晚。)
We got soaked on the way home without an umbrella.
(我們沒帶傘，回家路上全身濕透。)

soar(v.)高飛、猛增、高聳
(無詞性變化)
soaring prices 飛漲的物價
soar into the sky 衝上天空
An eagle soared high above the valley.
(一隻老鷹在山谷上空高飛。)
Housing prices have soared in the past ten years.
(過去十年房價飆漲。)

sob(n./v.)啜泣、嗚咽
(無詞性變化)
sob story 博取同情的故事
sob one's heart out 哭得肝腸寸斷
The little girl sobbed when she lost her puppy.
(小女孩弄丟小狗時啜泣不已。)
I heard quiet sobs coming from the next room.
(我聽見隔壁房間傳來輕輕的啜泣聲。)

sober(adj./v.)清醒的、未喝醉的、嚴肅的、使清醒
sobriety(n.)清醒、節制
stay sober 保持清醒
sober up 醒酒
Make sure the driver stays sober tonight.
(確保今晚開車的人保持清醒。)
The news had a sobering effect on everyone in the room.
(這個消息讓在場的每個人都冷靜下來。)

soften(v.)使變軟、使緩和
soft(adj.)軟的
soften the blow 減輕打擊
soften one's tone 放軟語氣
Leave the butter out to soften before baking.
(烘焙前先把奶油放在室溫軟化。)
She softened her tone when she saw he was upset.
(看到他難過，她放軟了語氣。)

sole(adj./n./v.)唯一的、獨占的、鞋底、腳底、換鞋底
solely(adv.)唯一地、僅僅
sole purpose 唯一目的
sole survivor 唯一倖存者
She was the sole survivor of the plane crash.
(她是那起空難的唯一倖存者。)

substitute(n./v.)代替品、代替者、代替

substitute teacher 代課老師
substitute A for B 用A代替B
We had a substitute teacher because Ms. Lin was sick.
(因為林老師生病，我們有一位代課老師。)
You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
(這個食譜中你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。)

subtle(adj.)微妙的、細微的、不明顯的
subtlety(n.)微妙、細微之處
subtly(adv.)微妙地
subtle difference 細微的差別
subtle hint 委婉的暗示
There is a subtle difference between these two colors.
(這兩種顏色之間有細微的差別。)
She gave me a subtle hint that it was time to leave.
(她委婉地暗示我該離開了。)

suburban(adj.)郊區的
suburb(n.)郊區
suburban area 郊區
suburban life 郊區生活
Many families move to suburban areas for cheaper housing.
(許多家庭為了較便宜的房子搬到郊區。)
She enjoys the quiet pace of suburban life.
(她喜歡郊區生活寧靜的步調。)

successor(n.)繼承者、接班人、後繼者
succeed(v.)繼承、接替
succession(n.)繼承、連續
successor to 繼任者
choose a successor 選擇接班人
The CEO has not yet chosen his successor.
(執行長尚未選定他的接班人。)
This model is the successor to last year's popular phone.
(這款機型是去年熱門手機的後繼機種。)

suite(n.)套房、一套、組曲
(無詞性變化)
hotel suite 飯店套房
software suite 套裝軟體
They stayed in a luxury suite on the top floor.
(他們住在頂樓的豪華套房。)
The orchestra played a suite by Tchaikovsky.
(管弦樂團演奏了柴可夫斯基的一組組曲。)

superb(adj.)極好的、一流的
superbly(adv.)極好地
superb performance 精湛的表演
superb quality 品質一流
The pianist gave a superb performance last night.
(那位鋼琴家昨晚的演出非常精湛。)
The hotel offers superb views of the ocean.
(這間飯店可以欣賞絕佳的海景。)

superstition(n.)迷信
superstitious(adj.)迷信的
old superstition 古老的迷信
believe in superstition 相信迷信
According to an old superstition, breaking a mirror brings bad luck.
(根據古老的迷信，打破鏡子會帶來厄運。)
My grandmother is very superstitious about the number four.
(我奶奶對數字四非常迷信。)

supervise(v.)監督、管理、指導
supervision(n.)監督
supervisor(n.)主管、指導者
supervise students 監督學生
closely supervise 嚴密監督
Teachers take turns supervising students during lunch.
(老師們輪流在午餐時間監督學生。)
Young children should be closely supervised near water.
(在水邊應嚴密看顧幼童。)

supervision(n.)監督、管理、指導
supervise(v.)監督
under supervision 在監督之下
adult supervision 大人陪同監督
Children under 12 must swim under adult supervision.
(十二歲以下孩童必須在大人陪同下游泳。)
The project was completed under the supervision of Professor Chen.
(這項計畫在陳教授的指導下完成。)

supervisor(n.)主管、監督者、指導教授
supervise(v.)監督
supervisory(adj.)監督的
direct supervisor 直屬上司
report to a supervisor 向主管報告
Ask your supervisor if you can leave early.
(問問你的主管是否可以提早離開。)
My thesis supervisor gave me very helpful advice.
(我的論文指導教授給了我非常有幫助的建議。)

supposedly(adv.)據說、應該是
suppose(v.)猜想、假定
supposed(adj.)所謂的、應該的
supposedly true 據稱屬實
supposedly the best 號稱最好的
This restaurant is supposedly the best in town.
(這家餐廳號稱是鎮上最好的。)
The package was supposedly sent last week, but it hasn't arrived.
(包裹據說上週就寄出了，但還沒到。)

supreme(adj.)最高的、至高無上的、極度的
supremacy(n.)至高無上、優勢
Supreme Court 最高法院
supreme effort 最大的努力
The case was finally decided by the Supreme Court.
(這個案件最後由最高法院判決。)
She made a supreme effort to finish the marathon.
(她竭盡全力跑完了馬拉松。)

surplus(n./adj.)過剩、盈餘、過剩的
(無詞性變化)
trade surplus 貿易順差
budget surplus 預算盈餘
The country has a large trade surplus with the United States.
(這個國家對美國有大量貿易順差。)
Surplus food from the event was given to a local shelter.
(活動剩餘的食物被捐給當地的收容所。)

surveillance(n.)監視、監控
(無詞性變化)
surveillance camera 監視器
under surveillance 受到監視
Surveillance cameras recorded the thief entering the store.
(監視器拍到小偷進入商店。)
The suspect has been under police surveillance for weeks.
(那名嫌犯已遭警方監視好幾週。)

suspend(v.)暫停、使停學(職)、懸掛
suspension(n.)暫停、停學、懸吊
suspended(adj.)懸掛的、暫停的
be suspended from school 被停學
suspend service 暫停服務
Train service was suspended because of the typhoon.
(因為颱風，火車停駛。)
He was suspended from school for three days for fighting.
(他因打架被停學三天。)

sustain(v.)維持、支撐、遭受
sustainable(adj.)可持續的
sustain growth 維持成長
sustain injuries 受傷
It is hard to sustain your energy without enough sleep.
(睡眠不足很難維持精力。)
The driver sustained serious injuries in the crash.
(那名駕駛在車禍中受了重傷。)

sustainable(adj.)可持續的、永續的
sustainability(n.)永續性
sustain(v.)維持
sustainable development 永續發展
sustainable energy 永續能源
Our school promotes sustainable development by reducing plastic use.
(我們學校以減少塑膠使用來推動永續發展。)
Solar power is a clean and sustainable energy source.
(太陽能是一種乾淨且可永續的能源。)

swap(v./n.)交換、交換物
(無詞性變化)
swap seats 換座位
swap places 交換位置
Would you mind swapping seats with me?
(你介意和我換座位嗎？)
We held a book swap at school to share our old books.
(我們在學校舉辦換書活動來分享舊書。)

symbolic(adj.)象徵的、象徵性的
symbol(n.)象徵、符號
symbolize(v.)象徵
symbolic meaning 象徵意義
symbolic gesture 象徵性的舉動
The white dove is symbolic of peace.
(白鴿象徵和平。)
Planting a tree was a symbolic gesture of hope for the future.
(種樹是對未來懷抱希望的象徵性舉動。)

symptom(n.)症狀、徵兆
symptomatic(adj.)有症狀的、徵兆的
common symptom 常見症狀
show symptoms 出現症狀
Fever and coughing are common symptoms of the flu.
(發燒和咳嗽是流感的常見症狀。)
Rising crime may be a symptom of deeper social problems.
(犯罪增加可能是更深層社會問題的徵兆。)

syndrome(n.)症候群、典型表現
(無詞性變化)
Down syndrome 唐氏症
jet lag syndrome 時差症候群
Many students suffer from Monday morning syndrome.
(許多學生都有星期一早上症候群。)
He was diagnosed with a rare genetic syndrome.
(他被診斷出罹患一種罕見的遺傳症候群。)
